name: free
description: Shows total, used, free, shared, cached and available memory. The column to look at is “available”: Linux uses free memory as a disk cache and gives it back as soon as a program needs it, so a low “free” value is nothing to worry about.

options.description: Splits the buffers and cache columns.

example.output:
total   used    free    shared  buffers  cache   available
Mem:    7.7Gi   3.0Gi   2.1Gi   312Mi   180Mi    2.3Gi   4.4Gi

options.description: Refreshes the display every N seconds.

examples.output:
total        used        free      shared  buff/cache   available
Mem:           7.7Gi       3.0Gi       2.1Gi       312Mi       2.5Gi       4.4Gi
Swap:          2.0Gi          0B       2.0Gi

examples.explanation: Shows the status again every 2 seconds (Ctrl+C to stop).
